needsAttention.title: Charlotte connection is now the whole game
needsAttention.detail: AA 5348 was due out at 5:28 but you're only boarding around 6:00 — so plan on landing CLT closer to 8:05–8:15, not 7:34. AA 2120 to Portland leaves at 8:25. That may be a sprint, or a misconnect. The second you land, check the board for AA 2120's gate and go straight there.

needsAttention.title: You're inside the AA hub at CLT — rebooking is easy
needsAttention.detail: Both flights are American in the same terminal, so if 2120 goes without you, the app will usually auto-rebook you before you're even off the jet bridge. If not, a gate agent or the AA app can put you on the next PWM flight. Not worth stressing mid-air.
